auto.d: A copy of your data is saved on this device. It never contains your bank logins.

time.d: If the device is off at that time, the backup is made as soon as it is on again.

keep.d: Older ones are deleted by themselves. The newest one is always kept.

folder.tip: To save somewhere else, type the full path of a folder. With Docker, link that folder in docker-compose.yml first.

pw.on: New backups are protected. You need the password to restore them, also on another device.
pw.off: Off. Anyone who finds a backup file can read your activity. You can choose a password for new backups.

contains.inc: Included: all your activity, accounts and balances, categories, tags, rules, budgets, jars, bills and your settings.
contains.never: Never included: bank logins, the Wise token, the app password and notification links. After a restore, your connections stay as they are, or you add them again, and the app will not import anything twice.

list.d: Restoring replaces the data in the app with the data in the backup.

toast.downloading: Downloading the backup. Look in your Downloads folder.
toast.pwMismatch: The two passwords are not the same
toast.pwOffConfirm: Turn off the password? New backups will not be protected.

rs.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
rs.text: This replaces the activity, categories, tags, rules, budgets and jars in the app with the ones in the backup. Your bank connections are not touched. A copy of what you have now is saved first, so you can go back.

setpw.text: New backups will need this password to be opened, here or on another device. If you forget it, those backups cannot be opened. Older backups keep the password they were made with. The app keeps the password on this device so the daily backup can use it.
